name: Demonstration watchlist
note: Every entry is invented so that screening can be shown without a real list. No entry refers to a real person, company, vessel or place; any resemblance is unintended. An installation names its own lists with DOCUINSIGHTS_WATCHLISTS, and this one is then no longer used.
